item.title: NYPD lieutenant busted shoplifting while working off-duty security at yoga boutique
item.description: Multiple sources confirm John Ruis was off-duty and working a security detail at an Alo Yoga boutique when he was caught on surveillance camera stealing a $275 charm off a $3,500 Alo Odyssey bag.

item.title: John Harbaugh retains Chad Hall as Giants’ receivers coach for Malik Nabers
item.description: Chad Hall is going from coaching Jaxson Dart to Malik Nabers.

item.title: Off-duty Nassau County cop killed in car crash; suspect charged with DWI
item.description: Espinosa, 42, began working with the NCPD in 2017 and was assigned to the 5th Precinct. Her husband and brothers are also police officers.

item.title: Pulaski Bridge partly stuck in upright position for 2 hours before reopening
item.description: It was unclear why the northbound side of the Brooklyn-Queens drawbridge got jammed in an upright position for about two hours.

item.title: Streamer Aspen Kartier arrested for animal cruelty after disturbing viral video
item.description: Rapper and streamer Aspen Kartier was arrested on charges of animal cruelty after a video went viral that appeared to show her beating her puppy.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 01, 2026
item.description: Small choices reveal big needs for balance. Initially, the emotional Moon opposes transformative Pluto, so we may swing between personal wants and collective expectations until we slow down. By the Full Moon in Leo at 5:09 pm EST, we can name what our hearts want and show it clearly and respectfully. We may need to set up some rules for continuing conversations, but creativity is still the focal point. Trying something new and being wrong is better than not having tried it at all!

item.title: Mamdani names Stanley Richards, formerly incarcerated criminal justice reformer, to run NYC jails
item.description: Mamdani entrusted Stanley Richards, who was formerly incarcerated and executive vice president at The Fortune Society, with overseeing the Big Apple's jails, aiming for both a safer jail system and reform.

item.title: Man punched out cousin in Queens, left him to be run over by car: DA
item.description: Jonathan Velez was charged with assault and reckless endangerment for allegedly punching his cousin Manuel Rivera, 39, to the ground in Ozone Park on Aug. 2, then leaving him there to be run over by a car, the Queens DA said.

item.title: Anti-ICE protesters swarm Trump Tower in NYC, chant names of crackdown’s victims
item.description: Chanting “Abolish ICE!” and “How many more have to die?” the protesters held up signs with photos of people they said were killed by federal agents or otherwise died during enforcement actions or in custody.

item.title: Asking Eric: Siblings resent parents for their clutter
item.description: Dear Eric: My parents are retired and enjoying the empty nest stage of life. They have a rather large home and my mother’s mobility has been severely hampered in the last few years.
